name: Templar: Testament of Resolve grants charm and mind-control immunity while it lasts
contract: Testament of Resolve 804228 reads 'granting immunity to fear, charm, and horrify effects'. Owner ruling 2026-11-12 (Q2): charm means mind control, granted in Templar code. Its DBC grants fear (aura 147 mask 512) and horror (aura 77 MECHANIC_HORROR) only; aura_ascension_templar_lifecycle (rev_20261112_22) adds IMMUNITY_MECHANIC MECHANIC_CHARM and IMMUNITY_STATE SPELL_AURA_MOD_CHARM and SPELL_AURA_MOD_POSSESS on apply and removes them with the aura. Native immunity (spell_immune, no attack submitted) against Domination 37122 and Mind Control 605 from the dummy reads 0 before the cast, 1 while 804228 is up and 0 after its 10 s expiry; Fear 12096 (whole spell) and Psychic Horror 64044 effect 0 (aura 12, EffectMechanic 24; its effect 1 trigger has no immunity, so the whole spell never reads immune) follow the same pattern from the DBC effects, as the control.
